title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
code_status: 论文提供[作者仓库地址](https://github.com/Yueeeeeeee/MRPD)，但本轮官方GitHub API返回404；未验证可获取本篇源码、许可或固定commit，不称开源已验收。

cost_assessment.basis: Appendix A使用Qwen3-4B、三个专家各300步，约46万日志轨迹；1536条/step、最长16k，8张H100、TP=2，需专家训练与多域工具服务。完整多专家campaign不在单A100/A30预算内。
cost_assessment.available_resource: Single NVIDIA A100/A30 or local Mac
cost_assessment.decision: Full experiment not reproduced due to high cost; review DONE. No checkpoint/data download or paid API.

summary: MRPD把专家RL训练日志当作随训练步变化的课程，而非混洗后的离线数据池。学生与专家同一SFT初始化；第k步合并各域专家第k步日志，使用日志采样策略的log-prob做importance ratio，重算组相对奖励的非对称clipped PG。 显式chronological log schedule检查、teacher-top-k加tail的reverse KL、日志策略ratio与0.2/0.28非对称clip、response-mean损失和冻结teacher/logging policy梯度。无真实专家日志/训练器/环境集成。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.post_training.mrpd_replay import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'
